facts.fact: Orange Digital Center Madagascar, one of 3 incubators in Miary Digital, incubated 10 startups in the south that received USD 15,000 grants each, after over 9 months of support.

note: A census of AI firms; names no hub, incubator or park.

facts.fact: Minister Delmotte says the first Digital Center, with labs, incubation and co-working for startups, is open at Ivato and a second is to be built at Tamatave.

note: Smart Village and public Wi-Fi are public access, not hubs.

facts.fact: Under Miary Digital, 45 selected projects went through an incubation course of more than nine months before 26 received grants.
The UNIDO-led Incubateur d'Energie Durable announces its 2nd cohort of 30 companies (20 startups, 10 SMEs) for a six-month incubation programme.
Technopole Madagascar says its roughly 6,000 m2 AI and tech campus at Andohatapenaka, Antananarivo, is under construction, with ramp-up planned for 2027 and full launch forecast for Q1 2028.

PIC3 says three regional incubators, NextA (North), Orange Digital Center (South) and Zafy Tody (East), will run 9 to 11 month incubation programmes for a second cohort of 45 startups selected after a call launched on 20 January 2025.

systems.owner: Projet PIC3 (Ministry of Economy and Finance)

note: No cities are named, so no several-cities fact.

facts.fact: Three partner incubators, Orange Digital Center Madagascar, NextA and Zafy Tody, gave the 43 Miary Digital startups a year of intensive support, the document reports.
